result.brief: 提出 ManipScope 机器人指令跟随诊断基准，通过干扰物、目标重指派与未来视频探针检验策略是否真正遵循指令而非固定习惯。
result.reason: Evaluation-only benchmark for robotic instruction following in simulation; diagnoses whether policies follow goals, with future-video probes. Enabling evidence for embodied world-model evaluation, not a representation contribution.
